timing: Recorded before new feature extraction and fitting; existing diagnostic outcomes are already known development evidence.
question: Is strong-shape failure explained by low-dimensional score scaling, by the PMF-to-shape readout, or by a lack of readily accessible shape signal in the current representation?

hypotheses.score_scaling: A positive affine correction may repair numerical threshold calls but cannot improve the original strict ordering. It is an explicit low-flexibility control, not a probability-calibration guarantee.
hypotheses.PMF_readout: An independently trained shape readout from the full predicted PMF may outperform the current uniform-quantile shape functional without modifying the PMF.
hypotheses.hidden_accessibility: A shape probe on the frozen 256-dimensional H2-model representation may recover signal not readily available to a linear probe on the PMF. This tests accessibility, not information-theoretic sufficiency.
hypotheses.label_representation: Matched probes supervised by raw-QC Bowley versus the true63 uniform-quantile Bowley isolate a target-representation contrast within a fixed feature/loss geometry.
hypotheses.alternatives: Sparse strong-shape support, nonlinear accessibility, shared sequence/structure ambiguity, finite estimation and prior stop-based representation selection can still explain poor probe generalization.

existing_backbone: Exact-replayed H2 residue_mean fold0 seed1701 best104; frozen parameters and eval mode; all train/stop/evaluation predictions replayed against saved arrays before any probe result is accepted.
partitions: Original fit folds2/3/4, stop1, development evaluation0; no new split, no protected data.

references: nonnegative-slope affine raw-Bowley fit on original predicted scalar
initial_probe_design.weights: Equal training T by inverse number of views, normalized to mean1. No rare-label oversampling or weighting.
initial_probe_design.scalers: Weighted fit-only feature mean/std, constant features zeroed. Target-centered weighted ridge with unpenalized intercept.
initial_probe_design.selection: For each feature source, choose raw-target lambda by raw-Bowley stop group-macro MSE, exact ties prefer larger lambda. Lock the same lambda for its binned-target partner; no evaluation selection.
initial_probe_design.bounded_values: Clip scalar predictions to [-1,1] for Bowley value error and absolute thresholds. Use the preclip scalar for ranking, with deterministic existing sample-ID tie rules; report clipping and ties. Constant-score ranking is uninformative and must not be credited as retrieval.
initial_probe_design.label_eligibility: Raw IQR>=1 and abs(Bowley)>=0.30 for strong-shape truth, matching the already declared absolute rule. This is not the complete historical source-percentile screen.

evaluation: Same protein-to-group macro continuous raw-Bowley MSE/MAE; rare union and each direction separately, with support counts
Fixed +/-0.30 calls: TP/FP/FN, unchanged threshold; fixed1%uniqueT budget per direction using original canonical-view/any-view-truth convention
Fit versus stop versus evaluation under the same fixed prediction definitions; no online-loss gap
Raw-versus-binned target intervention using identical feature standardization, ridge lambda and objective
Whole-PMF H/CDF/tails unchanged by construction and verified; unchanged PMF is not an improvement claim or proof of shape recovery
Fit time, parameter count, replay identities, input-level privacy/protection and exposure limits

decision_rule.promising_for_confirmation: A raw-shape probe must reduce rare-union raw Bowley MAE by at least10% on both stop and evaluation, keep all-object raw Bowley MSE within5% of the PMF-derived baseline on both, and not reduce fixed-budget summed TP on either, with at least2 additional summed TP on one partition. If met, compare all available matched-fold strong PMF baselines before considering a bounded second-fold/seed confirmation. These are engineering gates, not significance tests.
decision_rule.no_direct_promotion: No initial probe can replace the whole-distribution model or qualify a new scientific screening task. A scalar head can only be a separately stated development auxiliary output.
decision_rule.followup: At most one evidence-motivated nonlinear or paired-fold followup family before reevaluation. Freeze that new experiment separately before fitting; do not relax these promotion thresholds to obtain success.
decision_rule.stop: If no additional discriminating evidence appears, retain current candidate and report the tested scope; do not claim representation contains no information merely from failed linear probes.

primary_reading.read: Introduction and section3 text; linear probes are independent measurements that do not change the backbone. Applied here to regression, not claimed as a new method.
Sections1-3, particularly score transformations, ranking versus regression and ties. Its binary probability theory is not transferred as a guarantee for continuous protein-shape regression.
